The '''Dulin system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained [[Dulin starport]].<ref name="Platt" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> One [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the northern approach vector to Dulin [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] was temporarily closed for two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] due to the local [[City/Legends|city's]] celebration of the [[New Year Fete Week/Legends|New Year Fete Week]]. As a result, [[Starship/Legends|starships]] arriving at the starport were instructed to use the southern approach vector instead.<ref name="Platt" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dulin [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-14.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
